notes: CANopen characterization centers on the timing of the application-layer objects: SYNC period (0x1006), heartbeat / node-guarding timing (0x1017 / 0x100C / 0x100D), TPDO inhibit time and event timer, and boot-up latency, on top of the underlying CAN bit timing (set via LSS). Physical-layer (CAN_H/CAN_L) electrical calibration is a CAN / transceiver concern; conformance is established by CiA conformance testing.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: CAN bit timing / baud rate
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Verify the underlying CAN bit timing (sample point, baud rate) the CANopen device runs on; settable via LSS (CiA 305).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: SYNC period
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm the SYNC object period (communication cycle period 0x1006) and synchronous-PDO timing.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Heartbeat / guard timing
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Validate producer heartbeat time (0x1017) and node-guarding guard time x life time factor (0x100C / 0x100D).

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: TPDO inhibit / event timer
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Measure the minimum gap (inhibit time) and event-timer period of asynchronous TPDOs.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: Boot-up latency
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm the device sends its boot-up message and reaches Pre-operational within spec after reset.

lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.name: SDO round-trip
lab_measurement_targets_from_spec.purpose: Confirm SDO upload/download round-trip and abort behaviour.
